# Lifting where branching is finite

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`lifting-where-branching-is-finite` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](lifting-where-branching-is-finite.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> For every finitely branching process: the depth reached is decided; a configuration with courses of every length cannot fail to have a successor with them; it has one given EitherThroughout, exactly that principle asked of every such process; and a selection gives a run.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Some course of n steps starts at s (Continues); courses of every length do (Unbounded); the process branches finitely where the successors of each configuration are listed. A course of n + 1 steps begins one of n, and where the process branches finitely the depth reached is decided. (`Becoming.Lasting.Continues`, `Becoming.Lasting.Unbounded`, `Becoming.Lasting.FinitelyBranching`, `Becoming.Lasting.Continues.down`, `Becoming.Lasting.Continues.decided`)
2. Where each step of a decided decreasing family is met by some member of a list, some member meets every step, up to double negation; so where the process branches finitely, an unbounded configuration cannot fail to have an unbounded successor. No principle is used: the goal is a refutation. (`Becoming.Lasting.list_throughout_not_not`, `Becoming.Lasting.Unbounded.successors`, `Becoming.Lasting.Unbounded.step_not_not`)
3. Given EitherThroughout, an unbounded configuration has an unbounded successor, and of finitely many starts among which courses of every length start, one is unbounded (EitherThroughout.list on the listed successors or starts). (`Becoming.Lasting.Unbounded.step_of_either`, `Becoming.Lasting.unbounded_start_of_either`)
4. A selection of a step staying in a family gives a run from each member, staying in the family. Lifting: where the process branches finitely, EitherThroughout and a choice of an unbounded successor wherever one exists give every unbounded configuration a run along unbounded configurations. (`Becoming.Lasting.along`, `Becoming.Lasting.runOf`, `Becoming.Lasting.runOf_start`, `Becoming.Lasting.runOf_within`, `Becoming.Lasting.lifting`)
5. Asked of every finitely branching process, an unbounded configuration having an unbounded successor is exactly EitherThroughout. Witness: two decided decreasing families, one holding at each step, make the fork of the two chains of Chains unbounded; an unbounded successor is a chain start whose family holds throughout. (`Becoming.Lasting.TwoChains.process`, `Becoming.Lasting.TwoChains.branching`, `Becoming.Lasting.TwoChains.chain_continues`, `Becoming.Lasting.TwoChains.chain_holds`, `Becoming.Lasting.TwoChains.two_unbounded`, `Becoming.Lasting.TwoChains.side_of_unbounded`, `Becoming.Lasting.step_iff_either`)
6. Without finite branching: a root stepping to an arm of every length has courses of every length, and none of its successors does (the arm of length n has no course of n + 1 steps). (`Becoming.Lasting.Fan.Pos`, `Becoming.Lasting.Fan.Step`, `Becoming.Lasting.Fan.process`, `Becoming.Lasting.Fan.arm_continues`, `Becoming.Lasting.Fan.arm_bounded`, `Becoming.Lasting.Fan.root_unbounded`, `Becoming.Lasting.Fan.no_unbounded_step`)
7. Instance (periphery, own checker): in FiniteBranching a relation is the process with one move, Reach is Continues and Unbounded is Unbounded, and listed children make the process finitely branching; classical reasoning gives EitherThroughout and Lean's choice selects an unbounded successor, so its five lifting theorems (finite_unbounded to labelled_lifting) follow from the core. (`Becoming.FiniteBranchingCorrespondence.process`, `Becoming.FiniteBranchingCorrespondence.reach_iff_continues`, `Becoming.FiniteBranchingCorrespondence.unbounded_iff`, `Becoming.FiniteBranchingCorrespondence.finitelyBranching`, `Becoming.FiniteBranchingCorrespondence.either_classical`, `Becoming.FiniteBranchingCorrespondence.finite_unbounded_by_core`, `Becoming.FiniteBranchingCorrespondence.unbounded_child_by_core`, `Becoming.FiniteBranchingCorrespondence.infinite_from_unbounded_by_core`, `Becoming.FiniteBranchingCorrespondence.finite_initial_lifting_by_core`, `Becoming.FiniteBranchingCorrespondence.labelled_lifting_by_core`)
8. EitherThroughout is exactly the lesser limited principle of omniscience for decided families (LLPO, in its standard form in Becoming.Likeness): for every decided family holding at most once, it fails at every even place or at every odd place; it gives LLPO in its Boolean form, and LPO gives LLPO. Returning from the Boolean form to the family form needs the decisions as data. (`Becoming.LLPO`, `Becoming.LLPOForDecided`, `Becoming.eitherThroughout_iff_llpoForDecided`, `Becoming.eitherNever_iff_llpoForDecided`, `Becoming.LLPO.of_eitherThroughout`, `Becoming.LLPO.of_forDecided`, `Becoming.LLPO.of_lpo`, `Becoming.LLPO.decidable`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. The process is arbitrary; finite branching is a hypothesis (the successors of each configuration listed); EitherThroughout is a hypothesis of step_of_either and lifting, and a choice of an unbounded successor one of lifting.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- An unbounded successor without EitherThroughout: asked of every finitely branching process it is exactly that principle. Witness: `Becoming.Lasting.step_iff_either`.
- Lifting without finite branching: the fan has courses of every length and none of its successors does. Witness: `Becoming.Lasting.Fan.no_unbounded_step`.
- A run with no selection: the run is built from a choice of an unbounded successor wherever one exists, which the principle does not give here.
- That lifting selects effectively or realizes a physical infinity: it gives a run's existence.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise is used. The core declarations use no Lean axiom; the periphery declarations cited use only Lean's standard axioms (propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice), as their receipts report. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren, 16 October 2026, chose “Closest gaps first” on the I4 classification table. The table read FiniteBranching as a join candidate: Becoming.Lasting stated that every admissible course stays (Lasts, kernel_iff_lasts), not that some course goes on. This result states it, with FiniteBranching's lifting as the instance of the process with one move; its classical steps are EitherThroughout and a selection. Readings (the AI's, which Ren took on 16 October 2026 and confirmed on 18 October 2026, DELEGATED-CHOICES D43): courses of every length are not yet one course going on; where branching is finite, what lies between them is exactly knowing which of two branches goes on throughout (the AI's note: that is for one successor with courses of every length; lifting to a whole run takes a selection as well). The finite case is König's lemma (1927); constructively, weak König's lemma is equivalent to the lesser limited principle of omniscience (Ishihara 1990; Bridges and Richman 1987).

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [tests-fix-likeness-where-determined](tests-fix-likeness-where-determined.md). Reuses Becoming.Likeness's EitherThroughout, EitherThroughout.list, Decided.exists_listed, holds_below and Chains (the two chains and their listed outcomes).
  - Output: EitherThroughout and its list form; the process of Chains with its listed outcomes.
  - Input: The unbounded successor comes from the list form; the boundary's witness is the fork of the two chains.
  - Preserved conditions: The families decided and decreasing. [Likeness.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Likeness.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [market-supported-finite-transition](market-supported-finite-transition.md). Its kernel_iff_lasts is the dual: what no course leaves is what lasts every horizon, with no finite branching or principle needed.
- related, not a proved adapter: [where-a-run-goes-on](where-a-run-goes-on.md). Answers its next step, a run without a selection: within finitely many configurations a run starts wherever courses of every length do, with no selection and no EitherThroughout; where a test recognizes the moves a run is built by search; asked of every process, a run from every member of every family that keeps moving is exactly dependent choice.
